description: The ONLY soft-bake sugar cookie recipe you need. They stay thick & chewy for days! 🍪 #SugarCookie #BakingTok #EasyRecipe #CookieTok 🧈 INGREDIENTS: • 1 cup room temp butter (unsalted or salted is fine) • 1 cup granulated sugar • 4 tbsp brown sugar • 1 egg • 1 tbsp vanilla or more if you're fancy • 2 tbsp heavy cream • 2 ¾ cups flour • 1 tsp baking soda • ½ tsp baking powder 📝  DIRECTIONS: 1. Cream butter & sugars until fluffy. 2. Mix in egg & vanilla. 3. Stir in heavy cream.  4. Combine dry ingredients, then add to wet mix. 5. Roll dough balls in sugar. 6. Bake at 350°F for 9-10 mins (edges golden, center soft). 7. Let cool & enjoy the perfect chew!
transcript: Sugar cookies are in the top five of all time. Parki with your mama. Here's how I make mine. Start with room temp butter. And I mean butter, not margarine. Melted butter will make them spread really thin. Next, we need sugar. I mean, they're called sugar cookies. Then I add in a few tablespoons of brown sugar. It just makes the perfect chew. We need a hand mixer because our butter wasn't melted unless you want to arm work out. Now add in your egg and your vanilla. If you think it's enough, add some more. Now let's add my secret ingredient. Yes, heavy cream. This will make your cookie tender and melt in your mouth good. Now it's time for our flour, baking soda, and baking powder. Mix everything just until it's combined. Now grab your parchment lined cookie sheet, form your balls of dough, and toss it in granulated sugar. Add it to your preheated oven. Yes, it's on 350. Bake them for nine to 10 minutes. Remember to let them sit on the cookie sheet for five to 10 minutes. These cookies are so soft and chewy and delicious.
